description: Return the companies named across indexed fund letters, most letters first, each with the number of letters and writers that name it and a count by stated stance (new_position, added, held, trimmed, exited, short, watching, mentioned). Narrow with investor (a registrant CIK), stance and a publication date range. It is an index with links: no letter text is returned. Stances and counts are FinancialMD's reading of the letters (by rule or by a named model), not the manager's statement and not advice. Use it to see which companies fund managers are writing about; then call fund_letters with company for the letters that name one.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

investor.description: Only letters filed by this registrant CIK.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 10, at most 100).

name: fund_letter_companies

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ company { fmd_id, cik, name, ticker }, letters, investors, first_published, latest_published, stances { <stance>: letters }, links }], next_cursor, note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Companies named in fund letters
